top_five.text: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated into an unprecedented regional emergency, recording over 10,100 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths across multiple countries without an approved vaccine for the active strain.
A military drone strike on a market in South Darfur killed over 100 civilians and injured 113 others, while additional strikes disrupted power across Khartoum amid worsening humanitarian conditions.
A United Nations inquiry panel reported that 75,000 Palestinians have been killed during ongoing Israeli military operations as civilian harm and protection crises persist.
Cyclone Arnab struck India's eastern coast as a severe cyclonic storm, causing at least three deaths and forcing the evacuation of over 180,000 people in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
A 30-hour localized ceasefire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region enabled relief deliveries and civilian evacuations for nearly 2,000 residents trapped under siege conditions in Oleshky.

top_story.quote: A rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak originating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 10,100 cases and 4,900 deaths, with cross-border transmission into Kenya and Nigeria heightening global concern due to the lack of a licensed vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain.
top_story.label: GLOBAL / CROSS-CUTTING — Disease Outbreak

Middle East.headline: Occupied Palestinian Territory — UN Probe Panel Reports 75,000 Fatalities
Middle East.body: A United Nations inquiry panel has reported that 75,000 Palestinians have been killed during ongoing Israeli military operations. According to the panel's findings, military actions and severe harm to civilians persist despite ceasefire efforts, underscoring ongoing concerns regarding mass casualties and severe protection crises across the occupied Palestinian territory.

Middle East.headline: Yemen — Airstrike on Petrol Station Kills 11 Amid Escalating Tensions
Middle East.body: Houthi-affiliated media reported that a Saudi airstrike targeted a petrol station in Yemen, killing 11 people. The incident occurred amid broader conflict escalation, including intensified combat around Taiz and Houthi calls for the immediate evacuation of Aden airport. Regional diplomatic initiatives, including Qatari mediation concerning wider hostilities involving the United States, Israel, and Iran, remain ongoing alongside local fighting.

Middle East.headline: Syria — Jordanian Airstrikes in Daraa Cause Civilian Deaths and Inquiries
Middle East.body: Airstrikes conducted by Jordan against alleged ISIS targets in Daraa province, southern Syria, resulted in civilian casualties. Syrian authorities reported that seven civilians, including three children, were killed and three others wounded. Jordanian officials reported eliminating nearly two dozen ISIS fighters. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani and Jordanian Foreign Minister Ayman Safadi agreed to form a joint security panel to investigate the incident.

Middle East.headline: Syria — Displaced Kurds Trapped After Violence Erupts in Tal Abyad Return Attempt
Middle East.body: An attempt by internally displaced Kurds to return to their homes in Tal Abyad turned violent when hostile mobs attacked their convoy. More than 200 displaced people were besieged inside a local administration building for nearly nine hours. The return initiative was organized following discussions with regional authorities in Raqqa and Tal Abyad to submit land ownership documentation before clashes broke out.

Americas.headline: Haiti — Gang Attack on International Forces Triggers Troop Deployment
Americas.body: Haitian gangs ambushed an armored vehicle carrying four Salvadoran aviation technicians in Croix-des-Bouquets, northeast of Port-au-Prince. The vehicle was targeted with explosives and fire in an area controlled by the Chen Méchan and 400 Mawozo gangs. Although the four personnel escaped the burning vehicle, they remain missing, and intense local fighting has hindered international search and rescue efforts. In response to the attack and disappearance, El Salvador deployed approximately 1,000 special forces troops to Haiti to locate the missing technicians and participate in operations against armed gangs.
verified_figures: roughly 1,000 troops deployed by El Salvador

Africa.headline: Ebola outbreak sees 136 suspected deaths in DRC, officials say - ABC News
Africa.body: Ebola outbreak sees 136 suspected deaths in DRC, officials say More than 40 health experts were deployed to the field on Sunday. At least 543 suspected cases and 136 suspected deaths have been recorded in the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, officials said Tuesday. Congolese Minister of Public Health Samuel Roger Kamba said during a press briefing that authorities will determine which of these deaths "are actually linked to the disease." At least 30 cases of Ebola have been confirmed in Congo, officials said. Europe.headline: Ukraine — Localized ceasefire in Kherson enables aid access and evacuations in Oleshky
Europe.body: A 30-hour localized ceasefire was established in Ukraine's southern Kherson region to facilitate humanitarian aid deliveries and civilian evacuations in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. The pause in hostilities concluded without reported incidents, allowing initial relief operations into the area. Nearly 2,000 residents in Oleshky had been trapped under siege conditions since April 2026, cut off from food, water, and medicine. The United States brokered the truce to establish a humanitarian corridor for the isolated community.
verified_figures: Nearly 2,000 residents trapped under siege conditions since April 2026

Europe.headline: Ukraine — UN commission determines Russian strikes on energy grid constitute war crimes
Europe.body: A United Nations-backed commission of inquiry concluded that Russian military strikes targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure and electrical grid constitute war crimes and crimes against humanity. The findings follow sustained attacks causing severe disruptions to basic utilities for civilians across the country. Separately, Ukrainian military officials stated that air defense forces are intercepting nearly 60 percent of incoming Russian Geran-4 jet drones during recent operational engagements.
verified_figures: Nearly 60% of Russia's Geran-4 jet drones intercepted

Asia-Pacific.headline: India — Cyclone Arnab makes landfall
Asia-Pacific.body: Cyclone Arnab made landfall along the eastern coast of India in Andhra Pradesh as a severe cyclonic storm, bringing wind gusts up to 150 km/h, heavy rain, and power disruptions. At least three people were killed in Andhra Pradesh. Authorities evacuated over 180,000 people across Andhra Pradesh and neighbouring Odisha to temporary shelters. Storm warnings were also issued in nearby Sri Lanka and Nepal as the weather system developed.

Global / Cross-Cutting.headline: DRC/Regional — Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases as strain lacks licensed vaccine
Global / Cross-Cutting.body: The fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak in history has surpassed 10,000 cases and caused nearly 5,000 deaths since being declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in May. Caused by the Bundibugyo strain, transmission has expanded regionally with cases confirmed in Kenya and Nigeria, prompting health officials to warn of international spread risks. No vaccine is currently licensed specifically for the Bundibugyo strain. Clinical research is ongoing to evaluate whether Ervebo, a vaccine approved for the Zaire strain, offers cross-protection while specific candidates undergo trials.
